title: Docker Hub pull limits weaken unlimited CI assumption

canonical_premises.statement: Anonymous Docker Hub pulls will remain effectively unlimited for CI workloads.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: Anonymous pulls are expected to remain effectively unlimited at our CI volume.

canonical_premises.statement: Introduce authentication or a mirror if pull rate limits can interrupt builds.
canonical_premises.old_excerpt: Revisit authentication or mirroring if rate limits can interrupt builds.
